blocks.text: The API Keys page provides a repository for an organization to store created API keys. An API key consists of a Key ID and Key Secret. These two items are required for authenticating Workflow Automation APIs.

The API key can only be generated in the Zscaler Admin Console from the API Keys page. Key IDs are always accessible from the page, but key secrets are only available when the API key is first created, and they are not available in the saved configuration.
Workflow Automation API Keys provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Provide a repository of generated, authorized API keys for programmatic access to Workflow Automation API.
Maintain accessibility to the API keys by enabling or disabling them as required.
Prevent the misuse of API services by regenerating the API key whenever required or when you suspect vulnerabilities for an attack.
Ensure no further API requests are possible after you have utilized the API services by deleting the API key.

blocks.text: On the API Keys page (Administration > API > Workflow Automation API), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of created API keys. For each API key, you can view the following information:
Name: The name of the API key.
Created By: The email address of the person who created the API key.
Key ID: The ID of the API key.
Last Used: The date the API key was last used.
Expiry: The date the API key expires.
